CanonicalQueryMetricsOutput.description:
Process-cumulative actual query builder / SDK response populations. Not every SDK
select/control API uses this query adapter; no server-wide coverage is claimed.

builders.description: Query builders constructed; never interpreted as dispatched requests.

request_failures.description: SDK observer request failures without statement responses.

saturated.description: A count or duration saturated; exact increases are unavailable after this point.

server_duration_nanos.description: Sum of supplied server statement wall times, in nanoseconds; not CPU time.

source_started_unix_micros.description: First observed query-owner event; absent before any owner activity.

statements.description: Actual statements received before caller consumption, including failures.

statements_untimed.description: Statements lacking server execution time; absent is not zero duration.

ChildSnapshotOutput.description: Copied linked-operation summary; availability is explicit.

available.description: Actual retained child summary, never the parent's copied metrics.

finished_at.description: Actual owner completion time, when known.

id.description: Diagnostic identity of the associated operation.

kind.description: Bounded producer-supplied operation or phase description.

observed_at.description: Actual time this relationship was first observed in the parent clock.

outcome.description: Explicit owner terminal explanation, or none while active or unavailable.

relationship.description: Producer-declared relationship, independent of interval overlap.

ClockMapping.description: Mapping of one observation clock checkpoint to the same-host Linux monotonic clock.

monotonic_nanoseconds.description: CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds, not Unix time or process CPU time.

observation_at.description: Observation-clock sample immediately preceding the OS clock read.

uncertainty_nanoseconds.description: Elapsed observation time bracketing the clock read; alignment is not exact.

CoherentRecordBodyOutput.description: All members belong to the same source event; a read never assembles a mixed row.

coordinates.description: Source coordinate convention, absent when not established.

family.description: Versioned source family; native families retain different field meanings.

family_sequence.description: Sequence within this exact source family; absent after counter/admission failure.

norm.description: Source norm convention, absent when not established.

observed_at.description: Actual producer event time on this operation's process clock.

sequence.description: Source sequence assigned before lossy fan-out.

values.description: Complete bounded tuple; large scientific payloads use their existing owner.

CounterIntervalOutput.description: Retained additive interval, copied for passive narrower-window reads.

delta.description: Exact retained delta; absence is arithmetic overflow.

first_ns.description: Actual first source timestamp in process-clock nanoseconds.

last_ns.description: Actual last source timestamp, not a fabricated bucket boundary.

reset.description: Source generation/reset boundary affected this interval.

CounterWindowOutput.description: Bounded additive history; it cannot be reconstructed from arbitrary point samples.

duration.description: Duration intervals have open intersection boundaries; counts have checkpoint boundaries.

intervals.description: Retained second intervals, bounded by the same low-owner retention.

observed.description: At least one actual counter interval has been observed, even if none intersects this window.

partial.description: Retained updates are incomplete independently of requested interval boundaries.

Coverage.description: Independent coverage dimensions; loss is not hidden by otherwise available values.

available.description: Whether copied evidence is available at this read boundary.

counter_overflow.description: An exact counter exceeded its fixed-width representation.

curtailed.description: Collection or access refused observations; inspect the independent loss counts.

dropped_detail.description: Old detail events displaced by the bounded rolling ring.

dropped_updates.description: Producer updates lost to contention or attempted after termination.

enabled.description: Whether collection was requested; disabled is absent coverage.

interrupted.description: The owner guard ended without an explicit terminal explanation.

refused_items.description: Items refused by catalogue, field or collection bounds.

sampled.description: Recent aggregates or detail have reduced temporal/detail resolution.

stale.description: The active operation has no sufficiently fresh published checkpoint.

phase.description: Actual phase lifecycle facts when this detail came from a phase owner.

value.description: Copied value; this event never supplies scientific permission.

DurationSummaryOutput.description: Finite duration extrema; no inferred distribution or exclusive time.

overflow.description: A count or duration could not be represented exactly.

samples.description: Completed observed intervals; overflow is explicit.

ExecutorMetricsSnapshotOutput.description: Copied stable Tokio facts. Gauges are independently read, not an atomic scheduler census.

alive_tasks.description: Tokio's approximate current count, in tasks; not a settlement proof.

global_queue_depth.description: Current global injection queue depth, in tasks; excludes worker-local queues.

identity.description: Process-local registration identity, scoped by the enclosing process locator.

registered_unix_micros.description: Wall time this source was registered; counters originate at runtime construction.

worker_busy_nanos.description:
Sum of cumulative worker busy durations, in nanoseconds since runtime construction.
Unavailable on targets without 64-bit atomics; not process or operation CPU time.

MetricSnapshotOutput.description: Latest and cumulative facts remain available after recent detail has rolled over.

counter_window.description: Retained additive intervals for passive remote window selection; absent for gauges.

cumulative.description: Observed additive work since operation start; nonadditive fields are unavailable.

cumulative_partial.description: The additive subtotal excludes an absolute baseline or has lost updates.

duration_summary.description: Bounded owner-local duration extrema, independent of recent retention.

generation.description: Producer-declared generation of an absolute counter.

history.description: Time-coalesced actual checkpoint values, with an optional immediate predecessor.

history_dropped.description: Checkpoints or older retained slots lost specifically to history budget refusal.

history_partial.description: History coalesces detail, crosses an interval boundary, has gaps or lost observations.

latest.description: Latest published value, retaining explicit absence and nonfinite categories.

observed_at.description: Actual monotonic producer timestamp of the latest published observation.

producer.description: Explicit performing producer; absent for unscoped legacy facts.

recent.description: Sum of retained aggregates overlapping the request; partial values may include boundary work.

recent_observed_start.description: Actual earliest included aggregate timestamp, including any overlapping boundary portion.

recent_partial.description: Included aggregates cross the requested boundary, contain resets or have observation loss.

resets.description: Detected generation changes or backwards absolute-counter samples.

OperationIdBody.description: Process instance plus local sequence; never a semantic or cache identity.

process_instance.description: Process-local instance locator; not a semantic identity or attestation.

OperationSnapshotBodyOutput.description: A bounded independent read. Overlapping child times must not be added as exclusive time.

children.description: Bounded linked-operation summaries, with explicit unavailable attribution.

coverage.description: Independent availability, freshness and loss facts.

detail.description: Bounded actual-time detail prefix within the requested interval.

detail_partial.description: Detail events were displaced or updates were lost; aggregate coverage is separate.

finished_at.description: Actual owner completion time, when known.

id.description: Diagnostic identity of the associated operation.

interval_end.description: End of that lifetime intersection; may equal its start.

interval_partial.description: Requested observations exceed retention or have update loss.

interval_start.description: Start of the requested interval intersected with operation lifetime.

kind.description: Bounded producer-supplied operation or phase description.

metrics.description: Bounded producer-owned facts; child facts are never summed implicitly.

observed_at.description: Actual monotonic producer timestamp of the latest published observation.

outcome.description: Explicit owner terminal explanation, or none while active or unavailable.

phases.description: Independently active phase scopes at the last retained checkpoint.

producers.description: Explicit producers with atomic current and independently retained recent records.

read_at.description: Monotonic time at which this read was requested.

requested_interval.description: Caller-requested lookback, anchored at read time.

stale_after.description: Owner-selected freshness threshold; passive transport cannot replace this policy.

summary.description: Producer-declared responsibility and finite copied-output lifetime.

OperationalMetricsSnapshotOutput.description: Copied owner totals. Acquisition callers and shared producers are overlapping populations.

native_admitted.description: Actual active CPU/memory admissions in this supervisor route.

native_attempts.description: Attempts entering the native supervisor admission route; not scientific solves.

native_cancel_requests.description: User-cancellation branch selections while join was still pending.

native_deadline_requests.description: Deadline branch selections while join was still pending.

native_dispatched.description: Worker threads successfully spawned by this route.

native_joined.description: Threads witnessed joined, including TLS/foreign destruction.

native_supervisors.description: Current outstanding supervisor owners; not a physical-release proof.

preparation.description: Exactly frontier and basis shared-preparation populations.

saturated.description: A process counter saturated; exact increase queries must decline this source.

source_started_unix_micros.description: First owner activity in Unix microseconds; SDK collection start is different.

Phase.description: One independently active copied phase scope.

kind.description: Bounded producer-supplied operation or phase description.

token.description: Unique active-phase token; phase destruction removes only this token.

PhaseTransitionOutput.description: Actual phase entry/exit facts, retaining token and exact timestamps for optional export.

finished_at.description: Actual exit when observed; missing means an entry, not a completed interval.

started_at.description: Actual phase start, not export or read time.

token.description: Independently owned phase token within this operation.

PointSample.description: First and last checkpoint values in one observed second; intermediate detail is coalesced.

first_generation.description: Generation of the first value; compare across generations only when the owner permits it.

first_observed_at.description: Actual first observation timestamp, not a fabricated bucket boundary.

first_value.description: First value, retaining exact integer, absence and nonfinite meanings.

last_observed_at.description: Actual latest observation timestamp in this second.

nonfinite.description: At least one coalesced observation was nonfinite, even if the latest became finite.

predecessor.description: This actual checkpoint is the immediate second preceding the requested interval.

reset.description: At least one counter reset or generation transition occurred in this sample.

samples.description: Number of actual observations coalesced into this sample.

unavailable.description: At least one coalesced observation was unavailable, even if the latest became available.

value.description: Latest value in the second, independent of additive work aggregates.

PreparationCountsBody.description:
Structural preparations and value rebinds: of a math service, or of one operation such
as a study (A6).

rebuilt.description: Value rebinds that rebuilt value-dependent products because a consumed value changed.

shared.description: Value rebinds that shared every product because no consumed value changed.

views.description:
Structural solver-view preparations: a case plan, structural analysis and artifact
requests built from a bound structure.

PreparationMetricsSnapshot.description: One shared-product stage, process cumulative; misses supply no inferred invalidation cause.

acquisitions.description: Valid acquisition callers, including retained readers and all flight waiters.

flight_waiters.description: Polled caller flight attempts after the retained probe missed; includes capacity/retiring refusals. Producer ownership is separate.

producers.description: Single-flight producer executions, including a retained-product recheck.

retained_reuses.description: Retained products reused, including producer cache rechecks.

ProcessLocatorBodyOutput.description: Actual process locator. PID reuse must be checked before attaching an optional sampler.

executable.description: Current executable path for display/symbol discovery, not a content proof.

start_ticks.description: Linux process start ticks; absence does not authorize attachment.

ProcessResourcesOutput.description: Independently sampled process scope. Missing values are unavailable, never zero-filled.

lifetime_peak_resident_bytes.description: Process-lifetime resident high-water mark; it is not reset for an operation.

resident_bytes.description: Current resident bytes at publication, including observer/library allocations.

user_cpu_ticks.description: Process-lifetime user CPU clock ticks, with no inferred frequency or operation owner.

ProducerId.description: A performing instance, not a scientific or cache identity.

sequence.description: Unique performing instance within this process.

ProducerRole.description: Responsibility declared at the performing owner, never inferred from a metric prefix.

oneOf.description: Native-issued iteration or safe return checkpoint.

ProducerSnapshotOutput.description: One producer's independent current and recent record views.

current.description: Latest admitted compact checkpoint, even when history is zero.

recent.description: Bounded whole records intersecting the requested interval.

RecordAvailability.description: Availability of an optional source observation, independent of a numerical zero.

oneOf.description: The source interval is still running.
The source did not finish its interval.
The source did not supply this field at this event.

RecordCoverage.description: Source-record retention coverage, separate from independent metric histories.

history_dropped.description: Recent records omitted or displaced independently of current retention.

partial.description: Missing source sequences, refusal, overflow or publication contention.

refused.description: Records rejected whole by admission or representation bounds.

RecordFieldOutput.description: One typed member of an indivisible source-issued record.

availability.description: Structured source availability when not a completed measurement.

value.description: Exact value, nonfinite category or explicit absence.

RuntimeMetricsCoverage.description: Coverage of the bounded executor source registry at this read.

executor_registry_available.description: False when source synchronization was unavailable; an empty list then is not zero load.

refused_executor_registrations.description: Cumulative refused registrations, including registry pressure or synchronization failure.

task_scope.description: Only explicitly instrumented futures are covered by task class measurements.

RuntimeMetricsSnapshotOutput.description: One read of the same typed sources used by checkpoints and optional OTel export.

canonical_queries.description: Selected canonical Query-adapter SDK statistics; excludes other SDK APIs.

coverage.description: Explicit registry losses and selected task coverage.

executors.description: At most eight actual registered executors.

locator.description: Actual process/start locator; absence of start ticks limits identity evidence.

operational.description: Same cumulative native/shared-preparation source read by OTel callbacks.

preparations.description: Performing-owner preparation totals; nested operation/service summaries overlap.

sampled_unix_micros.description: Wall time immediately before independently sampled source reads.

task_classes.description: Exactly three process-wide selected future classes.

bytes.description: Copied opaque source-owned identity or reference bytes.

SummaryCoverage.description: Explicit lifetime/admission losses for producer-declared compact outputs.

expired.description: Outputs whose selected terminal lifetime elapsed.

pressure_lost.description: Oldest terminal outputs displaced to preserve active admission.

refused.description: Declarations or terminal copies refused by bounds/contention/opt-out.

SummaryPublicationOutput.description: Generic producer-owned compact explanation; it grants no execution ownership.

expires_at.description: Finite terminal output deadline; absent for an active declaration or a refused copy.

purpose.description: Bounded producer-supplied purpose, never interpreted by the hub.

TaskClassMetricsSnapshot.description: Cumulative library task monitor facts for a bounded class, in counts and nanoseconds.

dropped_count.description: Wrappers dropped, including cancellation; never a native settlement counter.

first_poll_count.description: Tasks polled for the first time; excludes wrappers never polled.

idle_nanos.description: Cumulative pending-to-wake idle time, in nanoseconds.

instrumented_count.description: Number of wrappers created, not native jobs admitted.

long_delay_count.description: Wake-to-poll delays meeting the long-delay threshold.

long_delay_nanos.description: Cumulative long wake-to-poll delays, in nanoseconds; subset of scheduled time.

long_delay_threshold_nanos.description: Actual monitor threshold classifying long wake-to-poll delays, in nanoseconds.

poll_nanos.description: Cumulative time within future polls, in nanoseconds; not CPU time.

slow_poll_count.description: Polls meeting the monitor's slow-poll threshold.

slow_poll_nanos.description: Cumulative time within slow polls, in nanoseconds; subset of poll time.

slow_poll_threshold_nanos.description: Actual monitor threshold classifying slow polls, in nanoseconds.

source_started_unix_micros.description: Cumulative source generation starts when this process-wide monitor was created.

ThreadExecutionOutput.description: One actual entered native-thread scope. Async migration is not inferred from this record.

finished_at.description: Actual return/drain from this scope, not scientific acceptance.

operation.description: Actual diagnostic operation executing in this scope.

start_ticks.description: OS thread start identity; missing means thread-specific attachment is unavailable.

started_at.description: Actual scope entry on the process observation clock.

tid.description: Linux OS thread ID, distinct from Rust's opaque ThreadId.

Value.description: A value and its availability are inseparable.

oneOf.description: Explicit absence with a bounded explanation.

description: One immutable process publication, never a scientific result or native restart state.

clock.description: Mapping to the same-host monotonic clock, with bounded read uncertainty.

locator.description: Actual operational attachment locator, not build provenance.

omitted.description: Operations omitted from this bounded external image.

operations.description: Current/cumulative/recent facts, including their own scopes and coverage.

parent.description: A parent diagnostic operation, when this process was explicitly dispatched by it.

process.description: Unique process-instance locator; PID alone is never its identity.

published_unix_micros.description: Publication wall timestamp, distinct from each producer's checkpoint time.

registry_coverage.description: Registry refusal/loss, including operations that could not obtain diagnostic storage.

resources.description: Process-wide samples, never a private operation's peak or exclusive CPU time.

runtime_metrics.description: Actual executor and selected-future measurements, with their independent coverage.

sequence.description: Monotonic publication sequence within this process instance.

summaries.description: Explicit compact-output admission, expiry and pressure losses.

threads_partial.description: Thread scopes were displaced or could not be observed.

version.description: Format version of this diagnostic-only representation.
